extracted.intended_audience: journalists and media professionals (also government stakeholders seeking Brookings expertise)
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions and contact points for journalists and media to request expert interviews, connect to Brookings' in‑house TV studio, and locate/latest news releases. Also includes a Government Affairs contact path for government stakeholders seeking research or scholar contact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request interview with an expert
rubrics_metrics.description: Journalists and media worldwide are welcome to request an interview with an expert, connect with our TV studio, and explore our latest press releases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact General Inquiries at [email protected] or 202.797.6197 to request interviews or for other media questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government Affairs inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: Government stakeholders are welcome to reach out to our GA team to request information on Brookings research or get in touch with scholars of interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Government Affairs at [email protected] or 202.797.6197 (listed on page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Connect with Brookings Studio for recording or live broadcasting
rubrics_metrics.description: For recording or live-broadcasting interviews with our experts, technicians in our in-house TV studio are available to connect you to our dedicated ISDN lines and answer any technical questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact the Studio at [email protected] or 202.797.6262. The studio provides ISDN connectivity and technical assistance for broadcasts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locate and filter news releases
rubrics_metrics.description: News Releases section supports searching and filtering by Topic, Region, Expert, Research Program, Date, and Language; results can be sorted and paged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Select experts / Select program / Select topics / Select regions controls and the Search/Filter functions. Results per page options shown: 10, 20, 30, 40.
